content: Traefik has no direct 'ask webhook' equivalent to Caddy; dynamic per-domain TLS is achieved via its file/HTTP dynamic-config providers — an operator-side script/service can poll Kurzly's status endpoint and materialize a router+certresolver config file per verified domain, which Traefik picks up hot and then completes the ACME HTTP-01 challenge itself. Every domain must already A/AAAA-point at the Traefik host; Let's Encrypt allows 50 certs/registered domain/week.
